No.23

The Truth About Appearance

"Appearance arises from the heart" and "do not judge a person by looks" — how to understand the two together.

Author's record · translated; the Chinese original is authoritative

Open in reading mode →

🔶Inquiry to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

I asked Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: the ancients often said that appearance arises from the heart, yet there is another saying that one should not judge a person by appearance. Please give a teaching.

🔶The Bodhisattva's Teaching

"The appearance of beings
is what the heart's energy shows."
"Nourish good thoughts long,
and the complexion grows gentle;
let bad habits remain,
and the expression changes of itself."
"Yet a person's appearance
is not settled by a moment's heart;
it is formed by karma accumulated over a long time."

"Therefore the world says
'appearance arises from the heart',
and also says
'do not judge a person by appearance'."
"One speaks of the root;
the other warns against clinging."
"To see appearance and know the person
may serve as a reference;
if you cling to the appearance,
you lose the person."
